why: Interfaces this engine implements as a JS class whose constructor stores its state in INTERNAL SLOTS (`KB.__slots` / the Event machinery's v8::Private slots, see core/korvus-runtime/src/js/shared-globals.js). Their accessor rows get the `slot_get*` kit bodies (the getter reads the instance's slot) instead of a stub, so `messageEvent.data` answers the message. An interface joins when its constructor is converted from `this.x = ...` (which a getter-only prototype accessor turns into a strict-mode throw) to writing the slots; the worker list is the subset worker-host.js builds in the other realm.

window.AbstractRange: Range (core/dom/range.rs) and StaticRange (host.js) write the four boundary members through the same v8::Private slot the Event machinery uses
